title: AI guardrails designed to stop hackers are now blocking defenders, and Orion-1 aims to fill the gap
summary: Artemis Security's new Orion-1 model is purpose-built for cyber defense and beats Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol on the company's own benchmark. The model fills a growing gap as general-purpose frontier models lock down their cyber capabilities, blocking defenders in the process.
